subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Emphatic
solution:
The correct answer is ** __Vigorous__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• *SYNONYM* is a **phrase or word with the same or well almost the same meaning as another phrase or word.**
 
• The word **"Emphatic"** means *something said or expressed strongly*.
 
• The word **"Vigorous"** means *something strong.*
 
• The meaning of Option A, *Vigorous is similar to the meaning of the word Emphatic*. Hence** Option A, Vigorous is the answer.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****

 
• The word **"Restrained" **means* not expressing strong emotions.*
 
• The word "**Hesitant"** means *Because you are uncertain, you are slow to speak or act.*
 
• The word "**Moderate"** means *medium, neither too less nor too much.*
